evidence: A screen on committed and bound products: the food study's mixes and their feasible ranges, the land-cities highlands, tubes and water lift, the ways-of-living settings and sky towns, the inhabited-volume envelopes and roaming case, the zonal-wind product's spreads and gathering, the heritage register, the population and computing screens, ecology's living light and sky ecology, resources' phosphorus routes and main's places, with two primary sources on free-space and Mars settlements. reading_rule: People in billions unless named; areas km2; water km3 a year; power, energy and heat TW (TW a billion is kW a person); phosphorus kt a year unless a key names Mt; mass Gt; shares are fractions and _percent values percentage points. moon.cases is keyed by lunar residents and those aloft ("6_3") and then by land rule. kept_30 and kept_50 keep 30% and half of every zone and of the sky wild; wild_30_hybrid_20 is the author's compromise, 30% wild and another 20% hybrid, and wild_50_hybrid_20 half wild and another 20% hybrid, kept for comparison at the author's request (assumptions.land_rules: closed is the share closed to farms, grazing, the homesteads' homes, cities, towns and sky towns, hybrid the part of each zone held as the author's megaparks and great gardens, the sky's hybrid part holding no towns; checks.land_rules compares them with the food study's). Capacities, traffic and the wild shares use the land and sky outside the closed share, which differs by rule, so used_share_of_dry_land compares the rules directly; sky.towns_grid_share_of_their_sky gives the sky towns' grid against that sky, and land.parks_km2 and land.parks_share_of_dry_land give the parks. Each case runs over 16 corners, every combination of the placement guesses with every input at its favourable and unfavourable end; full gives [low, high] over them all, feasible over the corners whose land bands all fit (null when all do), and remedy the same case with the dry highland towns poleward of 45 degrees first, the scattered communities on the twilit and Earthlit homes and the middle band's scattered communities on the fog-desert side of their homes, where some corner overfills (buildable_corners_by_parts counts the corners each part fits). bands gives each corner range's use, capacity and overfill by land band; the middle-wet zone is a band of its own, which the scattered communities' middle-band land (30-48.6 degrees) covers by area, and its fields are held to the food fill's room against the food product's rounding. moon.cprime gives the results of C' (C prime) by rule, and each distribution's moon.land_rules its own. Energy: primary_tw counts the residents' primary energy and the electricity at fusion's input, 2.0-3.0 W a watt (one basis); electricity_tw is the electricity alone; heat_by_component_tw splits the heat. fusion and array name the supply whose heat the Moon takes. The chosen food mix is the food study's power-heavy mix; food_menu gives every mix. distributions holds the four for the author to choose among; earth_sensitivity moves Earth to 8 and 11 billion beside them.

The array grows to 7 billion residents and the colonies to 5 billion.
